steps.name: usage-and-performance-signals
steps.summary: Added a domain-independent aggregate content performance contract for views, search referrals, shares, engaged seconds, and search clicks. Visitor/session/cookie identifiers, raw IP, user agent, and full referrer are rejected; only posts meeting explicit aggregate thresholds become title/structure/angle learning candidates. Actual collection and persona changes remain disabled until production HTTPS activation.

steps.name: persona-example-learning
steps.summary: Added a domain-independent persona learning contract that accepts only qualified aggregate performance candidates, stores bounded title/section/closing/evidence summaries without published bodies, creates inactive content-hashed persona versions, requires explicit activation, and records rollback to the predecessor on performance regression. No production persona was changed.

steps.name: failure-pattern-registry
steps.summary: Added a domain-independent generation failure registry for weak_sources, unsafe_claim, privacy_risk, no_evidence, and style_drift. A first same-day candidate failure lowers priority, a second identical failure abandons that day's publish, and further registration is rejected. Only bounded privacy-redacted summaries feed structured prompt and quality-gate guidance; failed model output fields are rejected.
